name: de Broglie-Bohm Theory
one_line: De Broglie-Bohm theory, or pilot-wave theory, is a deterministic interpretation of quantum mechanics.

math_relation_to_SQM.equations_summary: This theory extends the mathematics of SQM by adding a new dynamical law (the guidance equation) for a new ontological entity (the particle configuration Q).

key_claims: The complete state of a system is described by two fundamental entities: the wave function Ψ and the actual configuration of particles Q.
The particles' motion is deterministically governed by a guidance equation, where their velocity is derived from the phase of the wave function.
The wave function always evolves smoothly and deterministically according to the Schrödinger equation. There is no measurement-induced collapse.
